summary: The Void Sanctum is the inner chamber of Zebuxoruk’s prison. Void pressure, eternity locks, and null resonance converge here, forming the final barrier before reaching the prisoner’s metaphysical cell.
history: Constructed as the second layer of Zebuxoruk’s imprisonment.
Void pressure chambers were formed from collapse energy.
Eternity corridors stabilize the prison’s temporal structure.
The Sanctum Warden arose as the guardian of the inner sanctum.
